The main takeaway from our work is that
the magmatic arc of California is asymmetric and that the batholiths are not tabular bodies but are more akin to a stack of plutons with a variety of shapes and sizes.

the magmatic arc of California is not a simple linear feature, but a complex and highly asymmetric structure with a deep crustal root and a shallow crustal root, both of which are spatially and temporally variable.
